summary: DC statehood advocates are highlighting population figures and ongoing congressional interference with local governance, while raising concerns about federal control of the District's National Guard. Recent posts document attacks on DC's authority and efforts to counter them, alongside arguments against the current National Guard arrangement. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.
